index.block-2.title:
Web Experiment
"Write Once, Run Anywhere"
index.block-2.text:
PsyTask is WORLD's smallest web behavior experimental framework.
Fully compatible with jsPsych plugins.
index.block-3.title:
Self-hosted Online Laboratory
"All you need is a laptop"
index.block-3.text:
CogHost will be the core of laboratory informatization.
Participant profiles, online recruitment, online experiments, data archiving, real-time analysis, and so on.
index.block-4.title: Scene: Core of behavior experiments
index.block-4.text:
Any behavior experiment is a series of scenes, each of which is a stimulus-response pair.
PsychoPy-Scene is a PsychoPy implement of this architecture.
